export function createAiGatewaySessionListDemoData(query: AiGatewaySessionListQuery = aiGatewaySessionListDemoQuery): AiGatewaySessionListData {
    const normalizedSearch = query.search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    const filteredItems = aiGatewaySessionListDemoItems.filter((item) => {
        if (normalizedSearch &&
            !`${item.id} ${item.traceName ?? ""}`
                .toLocaleLowerCase()
                .includes(normalizedSearch)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (query.agentId && item.agent?.id !== query.agentId)
            return false;
        if (query.userId && item.user?.id !== query.userId)
            return false;
        if (query.modelId && item.model?.id !== query.modelId)
            return false;
        if (query.errorsOnly && item.outcome !== "failed")
            return false;
        return true;
    });
    const start = query.pageIndex * query.pageSize;
    return {
        ...aiGatewaySessionListDemoData,
        items: filteredItems.slice(start, start + query.pageSize),
        total: filteredItems.length,
    };
}
